title: fix: restore Azure Kontext generation
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces the Azure OpenAI deployment URL that now rejects Kontext with Azure's supported Black Forest Labs provider route.
- Restores both text-to-image and single-reference image editing without adding aliases, fallback, or a Pollinations GPU route.
- Keeps Azure cost at $0.04/image and applies the approved `0.75` multiplier, making the public price $0.03/image.
- Adds focused route, request-shape, edit, tracking, and upstream-error tests; focused tests and both service typechecks pass.
- Verified direct Azure generation/edit plus local end-to-end generation, editing, catalog pricing, one-time billing, identical-request cache hits, and a 5/5 safe burst.

gist.headline: Kontext finds its way home
gist.blurb: Azure moved the flower bed, so Kontext briefly lost the path. The route now leads through Azure's Black Forest Labs provider, and image generation plus single-reference edits are blooming again.
gist.summary: Restored Azure Flux Kontext text-to-image and single-reference editing by replacing the rejected Azure OpenAI deployment URL with Azure's supported Black Forest Labs provider route, priced publicly at $0.03 per image from a $0.04 Azure cost with the 0.75 multiplier.
gist.impact: Users can again generate and edit Kontext images through Azure, with working billing, request caching, upstream error handling, and safe burst behavior at $0.03 per image.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy garden path being rerouted from a blocked old signpost labeled “Azure OpenAI” toward a welcoming Black Forest Labs greenhouse, representing the corrected Azure provider route. Polli, wearing a tiny explorer hat and carrying a route map, guides a glowing Kontext image seed into the greenhouse while a retro terminal shows a simple image and edit panel; code-plants and flowers represent restored generation, editing, cache, and billing flow.
